services.name: Turtle Canyon Snorkel Tour
services.desc: Turtle Time! Duration 1.5 Hours About Turtle sightings are 100% GUARANTEED on every tour!!! We only take up to 19ppl onboard to maximize your comfort and experience. Escape the other crowded boats and join us instead. Our snorkel guides are some of the best on the island and they are extremely excited to share some turtle time with you. 50 minute in-water snorkel time. Our tour takes our guests along the beautiful coast of Waikiki, where we anchor at the well-known snorkel location called Turtle Canyon. services.name: Waikiki Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Join our Top-Rated Waikiki Sunset Cruise and experience golden-hour ocean views with Diamond Head and the Honolulu skyline as your backdrop. Cruise the Waikiki coastline aboard our spacious power catamaran, enjoy complimentary drinks, and watch the sky light up over the Pacific with one of Hawaii’s breathtaking sunsets. Enjoy golden-hour ocean views with Diamond Head and the Waikīkī skyline as your backdrop on a relaxing sunset cruise designed for unforgettable photos. Cruise aboard a spacious power catamaran, stopping at the most scenic locations so you have time to capture the moment, sip complimentary drinks, and bring your own favorites along for the ride.
